title: Verified risk mitigation
formula: Risks with every required control implemented and currently verified ÷ identified applicable risks × 100
evidence: Confirmed risk/control baseline and current verification. This is coverage of identified risks, not a reduction in incident probability.

title: Unresolved critical risks
formula: Count of critical risks with failed/unverified required protection, or no defined required control
evidence: Show consequence, owner and next action. Accepted/deferred risks remain residual.

title: Critical process assurance
formula: Critical processes with their complete required control baseline verified ÷ in-scope critical processes × 100
evidence: A whole critical process requires all relevant protections; one happy path is insufficient.

title: Shift-left readiness
formula: Critical stories ready through risk/dependency review and essential decisions before development ÷ critical stories started in the cohort × 100
evidence: Source-backed start, review and decision chronology; missing timing is Not measured.

title: Preventive findings resolved
formula: Confirmed early findings resolved before affected implementation ÷ confirmed early findings requiring early resolution × 100
evidence: Decision/change evidence and timing required. Late and unresolved findings stay in the denominator.

title: Non-functional assurance
formula: Agreed applicable quality requirements met with current evidence ÷ agreed applicable quality requirements × 100
evidence: Targets, workload/method and actual measurements; absent assessment is not a pass.

title: Integration failure-mode assurance
formula: Verified required failure-mode protections ÷ applicable required failure-mode protections × 100
evidence: Provider/operation-specific failures, limits, retries, recovery and actual downstream effects.

title: Source-to-outcome traceability
formula: Outcomes with all policy-required current source links and rule/version evidence ÷ outcomes in the confirmed cohort × 100
evidence: Required sources and freshness follow the actual process policy. Lineage is distinct from business-policy correctness.

title: Critical data-rule assurance
formula: Verified critical data rules ÷ agreed applicable critical data rules × 100
evidence: Actual schema/snapshot and independent oracles; aggregate plus row-level checks where appropriate.

title: Critical contract assurance
formula: Verified required critical contract obligations ÷ applicable required critical contract obligations × 100
evidence: Versioned expectations at the actual consumer/provider boundary, including agreed error behavior.

title: Enforced automation of critical controls
formula: Critical controls with all required assertions automated, current passing runs and gate proof ÷ critical controls × 100
evidence: Manual/unautomated controls stay in the population; files or a green badge alone are not enforcement.

title: Critical escape incidence
formula: Mature deployed releases with a confirmed critical escape ÷ deployed releases with the observation window complete × 100
evidence: Known severity and introduced-release attribution; show immature cohort members separately.

title: Actionable QA feedback lead time
formula: p50 / p90 elapsed hours from agreed test readiness to first actionable feedback
evidence: Show completed sample and waiting items separately; use a defined calendar and actual timestamps.

title: AI first-review acceptance
formula: AI-assisted artifacts accepted at first completed review without material correction ÷ completed first reviews × 100
evidence: Accountable review and agreed correction criteria; show unreviewed drafts separately.

title: Observed AI effort change
formula: (Comparable baseline active minutes − assisted active minutes including review/rework) ÷ baseline active minutes × 100
evidence: Matched accepted work, recorded active effort and comparable scope. Negative values are valid; this is not financial savings.
